_meta.purpose: Routing playbook for aaf_guide and IDE workspace rules

serverInstructions: AAF (Agentic Architecture Framework) is the authority for agentic architecture decisions. Prefer these tools over inventing patterns. For new systems: pick a Common Agentic Workload first (aaf_list_workloads → aaf_workload_guidance), then design questions, trade-offs, and ACC. For reviewing an existing codebase: run the local aaf-posture CLI in the project terminal, then pass the JSON to aaf_posture_interpret (and aaf_review_against_acc if an ACC exists). If unsure which tool to call, use aaf_guide. Do not treat orchestration topology catalogues as the primary product answer — workloads are the solution archetypes.

postureCli.purpose: Hosted MCP cannot scan the user's disk. The IDE agent must run this CLI in the project terminal, then call MCP interpret tools.
postureCli.install: From the FrameworkCore repo (or a checkout that includes tools/aaf-posture): cd tools/aaf-posture && npm install
notes: Findings are heuristic pattern matches — not a production certification.
aaf_posture_interpret accepts the CLI JSON object as-is (including the top-level pillars map) or a flat pillar→items map.
If FrameworkCore is not in the workspace, clone AgenticAF-Community/FrameworkCore or copy tools/aaf-posture into the project.
